thesis: The same pair, the other way: short the 2-year and long the 10-year. It exists in this book because publishing only the winner of a pair of opposite rules is how a competition hides luck.
drivers: Best trade: 2-Year 91282CPB1 (short, secondary-curve to secondary-curve) 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-08 for $1.45.
Worst trade: 2-Year 91282CPB1 (secondary-curve to secondary-curve) 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-14 for $-8.51.
3 of 6 closed trades made money; coupons paid $0.00 and financing cost $36.59.

Official par curve over the window: 3-month 4.02% -> 4.14% (+12 bp), 2-year 3.52% -> 4.74% (+122 bp), 10-year 4.06% -> 5.01% (+95 bp), 30-year 4.66% -> 5.35% (+69 bp). Duration exposures are paid off against this path.
